validation_policy.source_independence: Do not count mirrors or sites sharing an upstream feed as independent corroboration.
validation_policy.conflict_policy: Never overwrite silently; preserve each source candidate and require resolution.
validation_policy.missing_date_policy: Classify as confirmed_no_draw, confirmed_draw_missing_source, fetch_failed, parser_failed, or unverified.
validation_policy.model_gate: Only normalized grand_dragon records may enter the Grand Dragon model; never mix with other operators.
